tasks.short: Agree client solutions with rehabilitation specialists.

steps.what: Read notes from speech pathologists and rehabilitation counselors
Collaborate with specialists and occupational therapists to provide client solutions
Draft an unsaved collaboration note from the meeting

loop.input: The meeting audio from the collaboration, plus the client id already on the opened case
loop.output: A draft collaboration note naming the solution, the specialists, and the limits
loop.check: The later human step reads whether the agreed solution, the named specialists, and the limits match
loop.stop: After one redraft, or when she accepts; otherwise she writes the note herself
loop.why_not_simpler: The agreement is free speech, so a fixed form cannot draft it

steps.what: Check the drafted note matches the agreed client solution
Write the accepted collaboration note into the client record

tasks.design: The case conference stays a meeting. A bounded loop drafts the collaboration note from what was agreed, she checks that the solution and its limits are right, and only then does the {OTHER} client record store that accepted note. She does not keep a second handwritten copy.
tasks.previous_blocker: The agreed solution is free speech in a meeting, and the dossier can store only wording she has accepted.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft from the meeting audio can offer wording she checks before the record stores it.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether the solution and its limits are right stays with her, and a poor recording means she types the note herself.
tasks.human_edge: She is the one who knows whether the agreed solution and its limits are what the specialists actually settled.
tasks.altitude: Her week of case conferences stays. She still decides the client solution with the other specialists, and she spends less time typing the accepted note into the dossier.

reach.task: Agree how the client will use the solution at home
reach.learn: What that therapist needs in the note

evidence.claim: A consultation scribe can draft the note, and the clinician validates it before write-back. The digest states a 15 to 20 minute saving with no method, and that figure is not used here.

One documentation study reports self-estimated time per note from 6.69 to 4.72 minutes (29 percent), median editing 93 seconds, across 1,295 clinicians and 236,153 notes, with three of seven authors from the vendor. That is note time only and is not applied to the meeting.
Providers are legally responsible for careful use of generative AI: know whether it is a medical device, assess risks, train people, test, and monitor after updates.
The client dossier is kept twenty years after the last change.
Ambient recording that captures how staff perform needs works-council consent under WOR art. 27(1)(l).
The case conference itself stays with the therapist. Only the later typing of the accepted note into the dossier can shorten.

assumptions: The conference stays a meeting. The only system change is storing the accepted collaboration note in the client record. Messages that only arrange the meeting sit inside the meeting step and are not a send outside the organisation.
She writes the agreed solution into the record today. If the audio is unusable she types the note as today, which is the low end of the range.

The client id comes from the case opened in the first step. If it is missing she selects the client inside the check and does not re-key a code list. The note text is the accepted draft. No diagnosis code is generated. Specialist names stay prose she checks.
Other specialists' time is not in these shares. She accepts the note before it is stored, so the write is not a solely automated decision. The recording is not used to score her work.
The monthly sample of omitted limits or names is the extra hour. The per-note check is already the review step.
unknowns: Whether the other specialists are employed here or outside, whether the meeting is recorded today, and whether every conference already ends with a dossier note.
research_questions: How often this service already writes a collaboration note into the client record after a conference.

already_counted.description: The check that the note matches the agreed solution sits in the review step.

incremental.description: A monthly sample audit of omitted limits or specialist names.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A short agreed solution she already would have typed leaves about 4 under the net. An informal talk she still rewrites stays near 2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer tests and write rehabilitation plans.

steps.what: Administer tests with clients in the session
Interpret results and develop rehabilitation plans
Draft plan wording from her spoken interpretation

loop.input: The spoken plan points and session audio from her interpretation, plus the client id on the opened case
loop.output: A draft rehabilitation plan stating the goals, the limits, and the test finding she named
loop.check: The later human step reads whether the goals, the limits, and the test meaning match what she decided
loop.stop: After one redraft, or when she accepts; otherwise she writes the plan herself
loop.why_not_simpler: The plan wording is free speech from her judgement, so a fixed form cannot draft it, and the loop does not score the client

steps.what: Check goals and limits against how the client tested
Write the accepted rehabilitation plan into the client record

tasks.design: She still administers the tests and decides the rehabilitation plan. A bounded loop drafts the plan text from the points she stated, she checks the goals against the test, and the {OTHER} client record stores only the accepted plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan depends on how this client tested, which a form cannot see.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can turn the points she already stated into plan wording she checks before the record stores it.
tasks.still_hard: Scoring the test and choosing goals stay with her, and a poor recording still means she types the plan.
tasks.human_edge: She is the one who interprets how this client tested and which goals are safe.
tasks.altitude: Her week of testing stays. She still administers the tests and decides the plan, and she spends less time typing the accepted plan into the dossier.

reach.task: Set daily-living goals that match the plan
reach.learn: Which test findings change a kitchen or mobility goal

evidence.claim: A consultation scribe can draft note text, and the clinician validates it before write-back. That pattern is used only for the plan wording. The digest states a 15 to 20 minute saving with no method, and that figure is not used here.

One documentation study reports self-estimated time per note from 6.69 to 4.72 minutes (29 percent), median editing 93 seconds, across 1,295 clinicians and 236,153 notes, with three of seven authors from the vendor. That is note time only and is not applied to administering the tests.
Providers are legally responsible for careful use of generative AI: know whether it is a medical device, assess risks, train people, test, and monitor after updates.
The client dossier is kept twenty years after the last change.
Ambient recording that captures how staff perform needs works-council consent under WOR art. 27(1)(l).
The model does not interpret the test. Scores stay as she stated them, and administering the tests stays her work.

assumptions: She still administers the tests and decides the plan. The system only drafts wording from points she already stated and stores the accepted plan. It does not score the client or interpret the test.

The client id comes from the case opened while she tests. If it is missing she selects the client inside the check. The plan text is the accepted draft. Scores stay as she stated them. No diagnosis code is generated.
The session audio only carries points she states while interpreting. It is not a second dictation sitting. If the audio is unusable she writes the plan as today.
She accepts the plan before it is stored, so the write is not a solely automated decision. The recording is not used to score her work.
The monthly sample of plans that drop a goal or a limit is the extra hour. The check of goals is already the review step.
unknowns: Whether clients already consent to a recording of the test session.
research_questions: Which low-vision tests she scores by hand and which scores already land from a device.

already_counted.description: The check of goals, limits, and test meaning sits in the review step.

incremental.description: A monthly sample audit of plans that drop a goal or a limit she stated.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A short plan she already would have typed leaves about 3. A session where she still rewrites most of the wording stays near 1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train clients to read and write Braille.

steps.what: See how clients write Braille at the start
Train clients to read and write Braille

tasks.design: The lesson stays in the room. She trains the client to read and write Braille by touch. Nothing is drafted or stored, because the work is the practice, not a record release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reading and writing Braille is touch practice in the room.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new turns the lesson into a record task.
tasks.still_hard: Each client's hand and pace stay different.
tasks.human_edge: She feels the client's hand and corrects the Braille as it is written.
tasks.altitude: Her week of Braille lessons is unchanged. She still trains by touch, and no decision right moves.

reach.task: Practise daily tasks that use the Braille just learned
reach.learn: Which letters the client still confuses

evidence.claim: Braille instruction is in-person practice. The digest's scribe and image-reading cases do not cover teaching a client to read and write by touch.

assumptions: Nothing is built for the lesson, so there is no upkeep.
Any short progress line she keeps for herself stays inside the lesson. It is not a release into the client record, and it is not gated.
Lesson preparation stays inside the lesson. There is no separate filing step to shorten.
unknowns: Which Braille code the service teaches.
research_questions: Whether she keeps any lesson record or the lesson ends when the client leaves.

incremental.description: Nothing is built for the lesson, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The lesson is the practice in the room. No step is shortened, so the range stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week of therapy, tests, and lessons stays. Only the dossier typing of the accepted collaboration note and the accepted rehabilitation plan shortens.
reach: Agree with the occupational therapist how the client will use the solution at home, and learn what that therapist needs in the note.
Set daily-living goals with the occupational therapist that match the rehabilitation plan, and learn which test findings change a kitchen or mobility goal.
Practise daily tasks with the occupational therapist that use the Braille just learned, and learn which letters the client still confuses.
skills_to_grow: Check a drafted note against what was actually agreed, including omissions.
Know when a recording needs consent and must not be used to score her work.
role.ambitious_version: The same day the record holds the accepted note or plan, she is with the next client. The Braille lesson is unchanged.
